title: Interior designer in Kyiv — CAS Development studio
description: Interior designer in Kyiv: apartments, houses, restaurants and offices. Design project from $30/m², 3D, drawings, author supervision and implementation by one team.
lead: Looking for a designer who will not just draw beautiful 3D but take the idea all the way to a finished interior? At CAS, a designer, an architect and an implementation team work on your project — from the first meeting to the furniture in place.
about: How to choose an interior designer

Look at completed projects, not just renders: what matters is whether the designer can bring the idea to life. Ask what the project includes — without working drawings the crew will work by eye. And find out who is responsible for implementation: when design and renovation are run by one team, decisions do not get lost between contractors.
CAS Development has been working since 2016 and has completed more than 150 projects: apartments, private houses, restaurants, salons, offices and holiday resorts.
steps: We discuss the brief, style and budget.
A full set for the crew and a specification.

faq: How much does an interior designer cost?
A design project at CAS costs from $30 per m², minimum project amount $2 500.
Can I order only the design, without the renovation?
Yes. But if we do the renovation, the design is implemented precisely and the estimate is guaranteed within ±5%.
What kinds of properties do you work with?
Apartments, houses, restaurants and cafés, salons, offices, holiday resorts — in Kyiv, across Ukraine, in Europe and worldwide.
The concept and 3D can be approved online; measurements and author supervision take place on site.
